Class ReleasingBodyElements<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.ReleasingBodyElements<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
BodyElements<T>, AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class ReleasingBodyElements<T> extends Object implements BodyElements<T>
BodyElements that run a callback once when they are closed, by close() or by closeAsync(), e.g. to release the request body the elements were read from. Every method goes to the elements themselves, so that they keep their own rules and operations. Internal API.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • forEach

      public CompletionStage<Void> forEach(Function<? super T, ? extends CompletionStage<?>> consumer)
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Consume the remaining elements in order. The next element is read when the stage returned for the previous one completes. Elements that are available at once are consumed in a loop, so many of them do not deepen the stack. A failure of a consumer does not close the elements.
      Specified by:
      forEach in interface BodyElements<T>
      Parameters:
      consumer - Consumes an element, completing when it is done with it
      Returns:
      Completes when every remaining element was consumed, or exceptionally when reading the body or a consumer fails

    • closeAsync

      public CompletionStage<Void> closeAsync()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Close the elements, e.g. discard the rest of the body. An operation that has not completed ends with a CancellationException. For the instances of the framework, closing again returns the same stage.
      Specified by:
      closeAsync in interface BodyElements<T>
      Returns:
      Completes when the elements were closed, or exceptionally if closing failed

      public void close()
      Description copied from interface: BodyElements
      Close like BodyElements.closeAsync(), without waiting for it. Does nothing by default: elements that hold resources, e.g. a database cursor, release them here.
